summary: The diagnostic first attributes the step-62 RNG difference to attrib.c:exercise, but the missing source owner is potion.c:make_vomiting. The case title says “confuses”; C actually selects cursed-horn case 4 (rn2(13)=9), which starts 14 turns of vomiting. That state makes attrib.c:exerper call exercise(A_CON, FALSE). The later uncursed horn sees timed Vomiting as its sole trouble and cures it with make_vomiting(0L, TRUE), producing “You feel much less nauseated now.” Port the whole make_vomiting function and wire its existing callers; do not scope this as confusion behavior.

source.branch: make_vomiting overwrites the Vomiting timeout and marks the status line for redraw; when clearing an existing timeout, it prints the recovery message only if talk is true and the hero is not Unaware. In this recording, apply.c:use_unicorn_horn selects cursed-horn case 4 and calls make_vomiting(14L, FALSE), then the uncursed horn calls make_vomiting(0L, TRUE) for its timed Vomiting trouble.
dependencies: potion.c:set_itimeout: void state update that writes the Vomiting timeout field; its return value is discarded.
Unaware and You_feel: Unaware disables talk, and You_feel emits the recovery message only when xtime is zero, the old Vomiting timeout was nonzero, and talk remains enabled.

attrib.c:exerper (577-578): reads Sick or Vomiting on its five-turn status check and calls exercise(A_CON, FALSE); allmain.c:moveloop_core (354-356) reaches it through exerchk after gethungry and age_spells.
apply.c:use_unicorn_horn (2311-2326, 2362-2364): collects timed Vomiting as a fixable trouble and clears it through make_vomiting(0L, TRUE).

evidence: C recording challenges/cases/v15/wizard-cursed-horn-confuses-then-uncursed-horn-cures.session.json, segment 0 step 62, logs rn2(90)=3 for source expression rn1(90, 10), then rn2(13)=9 at apply.c:2267-2269. Since 9 / 2 selects case 4, not the confusion case 2, apply.c:2287-2291 takes the non-vomiting branch and calls make_vomiting(14L, FALSE); the recipe reaches this fresh Wizard through wishes and has no earlier vomiting-producing action.

The C recording at segment 0 step 65 logs d(2,2)=3 and rn2(3)=1 at apply.c:2341. The sole timed trouble is Vomiting (apply.c:2320-2321), so the one selected fix calls make_vomiting(0L, TRUE) at 2362-2364; the C screen begins “You feel much less nauseated now.”

The complete owner is potion.c:243-255: it snapshots old Vomiting, suppresses talk for Unaware, calls set_itimeout(&Vomiting, xtime), sets disp.botl, and emits the cure message only for !xtime && old && talk. The downstream RNG mismatch is attributed to attrib.c:exercise at step 62 because attrib.c:577-578 exercises Constitution when Vomiting is active; the saved diagnostic reports C rn2(2) versus JS rn2(20), followed by the step-65 screen mismatch.

The saved diagnostic .cache/synthetic-scans/v15/wizard-cursed-horn-confuses-then-uncursed-horn-cures.json identifies unported potion.c make_vomiting. In js/apply.js, use_unicorn_horn currently records that gap in both the cursed case-4 branch and the uncursed VOMITING cure branch (around lines 3375 and 3442); js/potion.js:healup also records the same helper gap for curesick.
